Marta (People Ops): Heads up — Jill (contractor) confirmed last day 2026-07-02. Need a short offboard plan: access removal, license reassignments, calendar handoffs, and benefits/COBRA note (she's on contractor opt‑in).
Jill (Contractor): Yep, confirmed. Final PR #432 is merged. I'll drop a knowledge-transfer doc and links by EOD Thu.
Anand (IT): Which apps/licenses exactly? SSO deprovision normally 48h after last day unless People Ops requests retention.
Liam (Engineering): Please transfer ownership of the shared Notion pages to me and add me to recurring calendar invites. I can cover weekly 1:1s for 4 weeks.
Sophie (Hiring): Freeze req-1346? Also we should export Jill's interview notes from Greenhouse before deprovision.
Jill (Contractor): Quick q on benefits — I'm on the contractor health opt-in. Do I get COBRA? If so, when does coverage end?
Marta (People Ops): Good call. Contractor opt-in runs through contract end date. COBRA enrollment mailer is generated by our vendor 7 days after termination; I'll confirm with Benefits and post the exact date here.
Anand (IT): I'll open a deprovision ticket. Actions I need: list of services to revoke and any assets to collect. Example deprovision command we're going to run:
```
# deprovision
deprovision --user jill@example.com --assets laptop,g-suite,okta,figma,jetbrains
``` 
Please confirm assets and if laptop return required.
Marta (People Ops): Created ticket HR-2026-87 — Anand assigned. Timeline: IT deprovision scheduled 48h after last day unless retention requested in this thread.
Liam (Engineering): Reclaiming Figma and JetBrains seats — can we transfer the Figma seat to liam@example.com and recycle the JetBrains seat? I need the seat assigned before next contractor starts.
Anand (IT): Yes. I'll transfer Figma and recycle JetBrains. I'll attach the asset tag and license id to HR-2026-87.
Sophie (Hiring): I'll export Greenhouse notes and upload to the hiring folder. Also can someone keep the interview recordings? We might need them for calibration.
Jill (Contractor): I left a Notion set with docs and a small video walkthrough: <https://notion.so/jill-offboard-brief>. Also pushed a README to the repo: https://git.example.com/repo/README-offboard.md
oncall-bot: Reminder: deprovision window HR-2026-87 scheduled for 2026-07-03 09:00 PDT
Marta (People Ops): Exit interview preference from Jill: video Thu 2026-07-01 10:00 PT. I made a calendar invite and attached the offboarding checklist: <https://company.share/offboard-checklist>
Jill (Contractor): That time works for me. Thanks everyone. One more — can we confirm whether COBRA mailer goes to my personal email or USPS? I signed up for electronic.
Marta (People Ops): COBRA vendor sends electronic first, then USPS if no action. We'll include the confirmation email in HR-2026-87.
Liam (Engineering): Small ask: please transfer ownership of the shared Google Drive folder to me so docs don't get locked. Tag me when done.
Anand (IT): Noted — Google Drive ownership transfer in ticket.
Marta (People Ops): Summary of action items: 1) IT deprovision & license transfer (HR-2026-87) -> Anand. 2) Export Greenhouse notes & recordings -> Sophie. 3) Transfer Notion/Drive/calendar ownership -> Liam. 4) Monitor COBRA mailer and confirm delivery channel -> Marta. 5) Exit interview scheduled Thu 10:00 PT. I'll update when each item is complete. :white_check_mark:
Jill (Contractor): Appreciate it — leaving checklist links in thread for reference: <https://gist.github.com/jill/offboard-links>. Will hop on the exit call.
Marta (People Ops): Thanks all. I'll mark the ticket with updates as we go. :wave:
